name: Roster Settings
description: Policy for duty rosters and check-in. Every gate here defaults to advisory: the aim is that the truth is easy to record and a discrepancy is easy to see, not that an engineer standing at the gate with no GPS fix cannot start work.

fields.label: Who Can Check In
fields.description: Anyone holding one of these roles gets the duty card in the app. System Manager always can.

fields.label: Allow Check-in Without a Rostered Shift
fields.description: On: an unrostered engineer can still check in and the day is recorded as unplanned. Off: only rostered engineers may check in — turn this on only once every depot reliably publishes its roster.

fields.label: Geofence
fields.description: Set the depot's coordinates on the Depot record. Depots with no coordinates are never geofenced.

fields.label: Geofence Mode
fields.description: Warn records the distance and flags the punch. Block refuses it — expect gate-side GPS failures if you use this.

fields.label: Default Radius (m)
fields.description: Used when a depot has no radius of its own.

fields.label: Require a Location Fix
fields.description: Off (recommended): a punch with no GPS fix is accepted and marked 'Location not captured'.

fields.label: Ask for a Photo on Check-in
fields.description: Prompts for a stamped photo. Never blocking — the engineer can skip it.

fields.label: Auto Check-out Forgotten Punches
fields.description: Without this, a forgotten check-out leaves someone 'On Duty' on the board for days.

fields.label: Auto Check-out After (hours)
fields.description: Measured from the check-in. The punch is written with source = Auto so it is never mistaken for the engineer's own.

fields.label: Mark Absent Automatically
fields.description: Marks a rostered day with no punches as Absent once the day has passed. Off by default — an absence is a conversation, not a cron job.

fields.label: Fallback Late Grace (minutes)
fields.description: Used when the shift does not set its own.
